description: This file contains internal number routines for base computations, including multiplication, division, and exponentiation, assuming an internal base that is a power of 2. It defines functions for multiplying, dividing, and exponentiating numbers represented in a custom numeric format, with specific optimizations for base 2.

methods.name: mulnumx
methods.description: Multiplies a number by another number, optimized to skip multiplication by 1.

methods.name: _mulnumx
methods.description: Performs multiplication of two numbers assuming the base is BASEX, using grade school algorithm.

methods.name: numpowi32x
methods.description: Raises a number to an integer power using binary exponentiation, assuming base BASEX.

methods.name: divnumx
methods.description: Divides one number by another, optimized to skip division by 1.

methods.name: _divnumx
methods.description: Performs division of two numbers assuming the internal radix, using a long division algorithm.
